clue.text: Ace holding up fish that gets played, finally

indicators.note: in a down clue the ace sits underneath and so holds up the fish above it

parts.note: the cod is a common food fish
A is the usual abbreviation for an ace in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: A card player holds up an ace while a fish on the line is being played at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: Every clue in this puzzle uses 'initially' or 'finally'; here 'finally' belongs to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A coda is the closing passage of a piece of music, the part performed last.

clue.text: Ignoring negative split, finally editor is satisfied

indicators.note: ignoring the negative means its letters are left out of the word before it, the word split meaning they are scattered through it

parts.note: nay is an old word of refusal, a negative

explanation.surface: An editor, after disregarding a negative dispute, is at last content.
explanation.walkthrough: The word 'finally' itself is the fodder: remove N, A and Y, which are split up inside it, to leave FILL. 'split' tells you the removed letters are not together.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone filled with food or contentment is sated, i.e. satisfied.

clue.text: Trees to come down, initially

parts.note: firs are coniferous trees
to fall is to come down

explanation.surface: A warning that the trees will be felled first.
explanation.walkthrough: The usual signal word 'initially' is the definition here, not an instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means at the very beginning, before anything else, a straight synonym.

clue.text: Inhabitant initially unsophisticated about time

indicators.note: about means the word for unsophisticated goes round the time letter

parts.note: naive means innocent and unsophisticated

explanation.surface: A local who was once rather simple-minded about time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Initially' looks like a first-letter signal but belongs to the definition: an original inhabitant.
explanation.definitionFit: A native is someone born in a place, one of its original dwellers.

clue.text: Part of OED finished and justified

parts.note: DEF is short for definition, the core part of every entry in the Oxford English Dictionary
ended means finished

explanation.surface: A section of the Oxford English Dictionary was completed and its contents defended.
explanation.definitionFit: Defended in an argument means supported or vindicated, i.e. justified.

clue.text: Initially, is doctor elated at result of brain operation?

indicators.note: initially says take the opening letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A surgeon is asked if he is pleased with how the brain surgery went.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brain operation' suggests surgery, but it means thinking.
explanation.definitionFit: A thought produced by the mind working is a notion, the product of mental activity.

clue.text: Final university tardy covering MIT up

indicators.note: covering means the word for tardy goes round the reversed letters

parts.note: tardy means late

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the letters are read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: A last remark about a university late in reporting on MIT.
explanation.walkthrough: MIT is the Massachusetts Institute of Technology; 'up' reverses it in this down clue before 'covering' wraps the tardy word around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ultimate means last, coming at the end of a series: a synonym.

clue.text: Leading part in drama, initially

indicators.note: part in says the answer is a portion of the following words, running across them

explanation.surface: The lead role in a play, at the start.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a leading part in a drama; the letters span the end of 'drama' and the start of 'initially'.
explanation.definitionFit: Main means chief or principal, as in the leading item: a synonym.

clue.text: One soldier, initially, aboard fancy launch

indicators.note: aboard means the pieces go inside the word for fancy

parts.note: ornate means fancy, elaborately decorated
one is written as the Roman numeral I
an American soldier is known by the initials GI

explanation.surface: A soldier at first climbs onto a fancy boat for its launch.
explanation.definitionFit: To launch a scheme is to start it, to bring it into being: a synonym.

clue.text: Kind of wings Daedalus had initially

definitions.meaning: a triangular swept-back wing shape on aircraft
the Greek name of Daedalus begins with the Greek letter for D

explanation.walkthrough: Daedalus made wings in myth, so the surface points at his kind of wings.
explanation.definitionFit: A delta wing is triangular, named after the Greek capital letter, which also opens the Greek spelling of Daedalus.

clue.text: Finally cut world record?

indicators.note: cut means the phrase loses its end letter

parts.note: at last means finally

explanation.surface: A world record is at last broken by cutting the time.
explanation.definitionFit: A book of maps is a record of the world, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Article finally reduced, helping to make new version

indicators.note: finally reduced means the word for article loses its last letter

parts.note: an item is an article, a thing
a ration is a helping or portion

explanation.surface: An article is cut down at the end, a share helping produce a new edition.
explanation.definitionFit: Each repeat of a process yielding a fresh draft is one step of revision: a new version.

clue.text: What's finally written need not change

indicators.note: change says the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Words written at the end need not be altered.
explanation.definitionFit: A note placed at the end of a book or chapter is written last.

clue.text: Tests officer, initially, with fire directed upwards

indicators.note: in a down clue directed upwards means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: a sergeant major is known by the initials SM
to axe someone is to sack or fire them

explanation.surface: An officer sets tests with gunfire pointed at the sky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fire' looks like shooting, but means dismiss; 'directed upwards' reverses SMAXE.
explanation.definitionFit: Exams are formal tests of knowledge, a plural synonym.

clue.text: Players of music initially assembled?

parts.note: disc jockeys are called DJs from their initials, and spelling those letters out as words assembles the answer

explanation.surface: Musicians gather at the start of a gig.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Players of music' suggests musicians, but they are people who play records; DJ is the initials of disc jockey, spelt out letter by letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Disc jockeys play recorded music, so they are players of music in a different sense.

clue.text: Saving money with false claim on author, initially

indicators.note: initially means the author's name goes at the front

parts.note: Umberto Eco was an Italian author

indicators.note: false says the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Saving money by making a false claim on an author's royalties.
explanation.definitionFit: Economical means thrifty, careful not to waste cash: a synonym.

clue.text: Initiate top player on time

indicators.note: in a down clue on means the star sits above the time letter

parts.note: a star is a top performer

explanation.surface: Bring on a top player at the right moment.
explanation.definitionFit: To start something is to begin or launch it, a synonym.

clue.text: Characters in old script from beginning also finish

parts.note: the first Greek letter is used figuratively for the beginning
and means also
the last Greek letter is used figuratively for the end

explanation.surface: Letters in an ancient manuscript, read from start to finish.
explanation.definitionFit: These are the first and last letters of Greek, an old script, giving a phrase meaning the whole thing.

clue.text: Start off initially in drug trial with least sense

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis

indicators.note: in means that letter goes inside the drug and trial words

parts.note: a test is a trial

indicators.note: the start of the next word, its opening letter, is taken

explanation.surface: A first-stage drug trial run by the least sensible people.
explanation.definitionFit: Pottiest is the superlative of potty, British slang for slightly crazy, so lacking most in sense.

clue.text: See 17
Words initially put together in a piece of writing about friend

indicators.note: about means the A and the writing go around the friend word

parts.note: MS is the abbreviation for manuscript, a piece of writing
a crony is a close friend

explanation.surface: First words assembled in a written piece about a friend.
explanation.definitionFit: Acronyms are words formed from the first letters of other words.

clue.text: See 17
Line crossed by me, not an inhabitant initially

indicators.note: crossed by means the word for me goes across, around, the line letter

parts.note: the setter of the crossword refers to themselves as me

explanation.surface: A boundary line crossed by someone who was not originally from there.
explanation.definitionFit: A settler arrives in a place and makes a home there, so was not born there.

clue.text: Very well packing trunk, finally fit in small volume

indicators.note: packing means the trunk word holds the agreement word inside

parts.note: a bole is a tree trunk
OK means very well, agreed

indicators.note: finally says take the last letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Packing a trunk well, with a small book squeezed in at the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trunk' suggests luggage, but it is a tree's.
explanation.definitionFit: A booklet is a little book, a thin printed volume.

clue.text: Initially establishing container, finally good

indicators.note: finally means the good letter goes at the end

parts.note: a basin is a bowl, a container

explanation.surface: Setting up a container first, with a good one at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Basing something somewhere is founding it there, establishing it from the start.

clue.text: Distance definable, for me, as initially in four pieces

definitions.meaning: an old measure of distance, about three miles

definitions.text: definable, for me, as initially in four pieces
definitions.meaning: the word initially split into four pieces reads in it I ally, which is what an alliance means for me as a member

explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' here is fodder, not a signal: split as IN IT I ALLY it describes membership of an alliance from the speaker's viewpoint.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both an old unit of length and an alliance of members joined together.

clue.text: Informs about rise in cash used in 1971, finally

indicators.note: about means the informs word goes around the rise word

parts.note: to sing is slang for to inform on someone
a hill is a rise in the ground

explanation.surface: Someone informs about a sharp rise in cash at the end of 1971.
explanation.walkthrough: SHILLINGS were British coins worth a twentieth of a pound, withdrawn when Britain went decimal in 1971.
explanation.definitionFit: These coins were last legal tender around 1971, the year of the decimal changeover.

clue.text: Preserve discussions to reduce nuclear danger, initially

definitions.meaning: to cure meat or fish with a mineral, preserving it

definitions.text: discussions to reduce nuclear danger, initially
definitions.meaning: the Strategic Arms Limitation Talks between the US and USSR, known by their initials

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a curing agent verb and the acronym of the Cold War arms limitation talks.

clue.text: Old instrument some finally retuned

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: An ancient instrument that some musician at last tuned again.
explanation.definitionFit: The lyre is an ancient Greek stringed instrument, a harp-like ancestor.

clue.text: Stupid way clue and puzzle finish

definitions.meaning: both words clue and puzzle end in the letter E

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer as IN AN E: that is how the words 'clue' and 'puzzle' finish.
explanation.definitionFit: Inane means silly or pointless, a synonym for stupid.

clue.text: Place for couple, initially, in gated enclave

indicators.note: in says the answer is found within the following words, across the gap

explanation.surface: A first home for a couple in a gated community.
explanation.walkthrough: The garden in Genesis was home to Adam and Eve, the first couple.
explanation.definitionFit: The biblical garden was where the first pair, Adam and Eve, lived at the beginning.

clue.text: Scientific device initially put together in 1960

definitions.text: Scientific device initially put together in 1960

parts.words: Scientific device initially put together in 1960
parts.note: the device was first built in 1960 and its name is made from initials, light amplification by stimulated emission of radiation

explanation.walkthrough: 'initially put together' means both first assembled and a word formed of initials.
explanation.definitionFit: The first working light-amplifying beam device was built by Maiman in 1960, and its name is an acronym.

clue.text: Initially reduced a lot in adult? Very little

indicators.note: in means the shortened word goes inside the adult word

parts.note: mature means grown up, adult

indicators.note: reduced a lot says most of that word is cut away, leaving only its first three letters

explanation.surface: A grown-up much reduced at first, now very small.
explanation.definitionFit: A miniature is a tiny version of something, so the word means very small.
